messages:
marie_cs: Heads-up — Acme reported a visible behavior change after our v3.2.1 rollout to hosted. They say previously the API returned compact JSON arrays for our reranker endpoint and now it sometimes prepends a long natural-language apology/clarifier before the JSON blob. Example customer paste (sanitized):

```
Request id: r-9f3b2c
Prompt: \"Rank these items by relevance given query: 'refund policy'\"
Expected (previously):
[{\"id\":\"p1\",\"score\":0.98},{\"id\":\"p3\",\"score\":0.81}]

Actual (today):
\"Sorry, I might be misunderstanding your intent — below are my suggested rankings:\" 
[{\"id\":\"p1\",\"score\":0.98},{\"id\":\"p3\",\"score\":0.81}]
```

marie_cs: Customer says this breaks their strict JSON parser and started right after the rollout. They provided 3 failing requests and timestamps. Requesting triage + repro steps. :confused: @devon_eng @sam_research

deploy-bot: v3.2.1 deployed to hosted-us-east-1 at 2026-03-11T04:12:03Z (release: inference/v3.2.1)

devon_eng: Thanks @marie_cs. Can you paste the exact API call (headers + body) for one of the failing requests? Need model param, temperature, top_p, and any system messages. Also the request_id if available. If Acme is comfortable, we also need the raw response bytes and a timestamp to find it in our logs.

marie_cs: Pasting sanitized curl from customer (they agreed to share):

```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk-live-REDACTED\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -H \"X-Request-ID: r-9f3b2c\" \
  -d '{
    "model": "gpt-redwood-7b",
    "messages": [{"role":"system","content":"You are a concise JSON-only ranking model."},{"role":"user","content":"Rank items by relevance to: refund policy"}],
    "temperature": 0.0,
    "max_tokens": 150
  }'
```

marie_cs: Customer also attached the raw response (sanitized):

```
\"Sorry, I may be misunderstanding...\"\n[{\"id\":\"p1\",\"score\":0.98}, ...]
```

sam_research: Interesting — looks like the model is injecting a prefatory sentence despite the system instruction. Two likely hypotheses: 1) rollout changed a default safety/heuristics wrapper that adds clarifiers when system persona is terse, or 2) a model mix/routing swapped to a variant with a different system priming.

devon_eng: I can try to repro in our sandbox. Quick ask: can @marie_cs paste the exact model string the customer used (full model id we can match in the catalog) and the exact epoch/region? Also share the 2 other request IDs. I'll run the same body locally and with our fallback model.

marie_cs: Other request ids: r-9f3b2d, r-9f3b2e. Model field they sent was exactly "gpt-redwood-7b". Region header wasn't present — they hit the global endpoint. They attached timestamps: 2026-03-11T04:18:22Z, 04:21:10Z, 04:27:03Z.

devon_eng: Thanks. Reproduced locally against hosted using that body: I get the prefatory sentence at temp=0.0 but if I set temperature to 0.2 the extra sentence disappears.

```
# repro commands I ran
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TEST\" -d '{"model":"gpt-redwood-7b","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are a concise JSON-only ranking model."},{"role":"user","content":"Rank items by relevance to: refund policy"}],"temperature":0.0}'

# output (abridged)
\"Sorry, I may be misunderstanding your intent — below are my suggested rankings:\n[{\"id\":\"p1\",\"score\":0.98}, ...]\"
```

sam_research: That temperature sensitivity suggests something in the model's decoding distribution got nudged — could be a token-favoring emergent phrase in top-1 at lower temperatures after weight-only quant or a new system-prompt fusion. Two next steps: (A) get the exact kernel/quantization profile used in the rollout (ask eng-runtime), (B) request the customer's full request + response logs so we can inspect the raw token stream.

devon_eng: I'll open an infra ticket to fetch the kernel/quant config for v3.2.1 rollout and also run an A/B where I pin the model to the previous revision (v3.2.0) for Acme's account to confirm regression. If the customer agrees, we can do a temporary pin.

marie_cs: Acme agreed to pin for 24h if that is low-friction. They also consented to share full logs under NDA. I'll coordinate the NDA and get them the log bundle.

devon_eng: Action items:
- devon_eng: request rollout quant/kernel config from eng-runtime (ticket #INF-4122)
- devon_eng: run pinned-v3.2.0 test for Acme and report diff
- marie_cs: get signed consent + upload of full request/response logs (sanitized?) from customer
- sam_research: try minimal prompt ablation to create a deterministic repro (system message variations)

marie_cs: One more thing — customer said this only occurs for short, strict system messages like the one above. For longer system role instructions they don't see it. Passing that along.

devon_eng: Noted. I'll target a minimal repro matrix: temp {0.0,0.1,0.2}, system message {"concise JSON-only ranking model","You output JSON only. No extra text."} and model {gpt-redwood-7b, gpt-redwood-7b-quant}. I'll post results in this thread.

sam_research: If we can replicate deterministically, we should add a unit eval (prompt test) and a quality-regression alert to Redwood Optimize so we catch future rollouts.

marie_cs: Thanks team — passing all this to Acme and will return with the NDA + log bundle. Customer asked for ETA — I'll say ~24-48h to pin and confirm.

devon_eng: Received. Starting triage now. Will follow up with status and attach the repro commands and diff once done.

marie_cs: (added) customer gave explicit consent to include the exact system message and one failing request in an internal ticket; said they prefer pin over rollback if it reduces outage. :+1:
